public static int writeTo(DataOutput out, LinkedBuffer node) throws IOException {
    Object[] buffer = node.getBuffer(); // Get the buffer array
    int pos = node.getWriterIndex(); // Get the current write position
    int size = buffer.length; // Get the buffer size

    while (pos < size) { // While there are still bytes to write
        if (node.getChunk(pos) == null) { // If the chunk is null
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unchunked buffer"); // Throw an exception
        }
        int length = node.getChunk(pos).length; // Get the length of the chunk
        out.write(buffer, pos, length); // Write the chunk to the output
        pos += length; // Update the write position
    }

    return buffer.length; // Return the total content size of the buffer
}
